title.english: Waiting for You to Say Continue

pairs.target: dìèrtiān shàngwǔ , tǎ wéi dào liànxí shì shí , luò héng zhèng dūn zài ménkǒu , bǎ xiédǐ de yìgēn zhú cì báchūlái .
pairs.english: The next morning, when Tavi reached the practice room, Lohen was crouching by the door, pulling a bamboo splinter from his shoe sole.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天上午，塔维到练习室时，洛衡正蹲在门口，把鞋底的一根竹刺拔出来。

pairs.target: zhú cì duàn le bànjié , tā táitóu kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiān wèn yǒuméiyǒu xiǎo nièzi .
pairs.english: The splinter had snapped halfway; looking up and seeing Tavi, he first asked whether there were any small tweezers.
pairs.hanzi: 竹刺断了半截，他抬头看见塔维，先问有没有小镊子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu , biàn tì tā bǎmén chēngzhù , ràng guāng luò zài xiédǐ shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi had none, so he held the door open for him, letting the light fall on the shoe sole.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有，便替他把门撑住，让光落在鞋底上。

pairs.target: děng nà diǎn jiāntóu zhōngyú chūlái , dìèrbiàn zhōng yǐjīng qiāo guò , luò héng mà le yìshēng , bǎ xié wǎng dìshàng kē le kē .
pairs.english: By the time that little tip finally came out, the bell had already rung a second time; Lohen cursed and knocked his shoe against the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 等那点尖头终于出来，第二遍钟已经敲过，洛衡骂了一声，把鞋往地上磕了磕。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu cuī tāmen , xiān jiào luò héng xǐshǒu , zài bǎ liǎng rén de liànxí zhǐ fàngzài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey did not hurry them; she first told Lohen to wash his hands, then placed the two students’ practice sheets together.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有催他们，先叫洛衡洗手，再把两人的练习纸放在一起。

pairs.target: luò héng zìjǐ de ānpái zài hòumiàn , yǎnxià zhè kèzhōng , tā dāying tì tǎ wéi zhuǎn luógǎn .
pairs.english: Lohen had his own session later; for this quarter hour, he had agreed to turn the screw for Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡自己的安排在后面，眼下这刻钟，他答应替塔维转螺杆。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng de réng shì tǎ wéi yòngguàn de nà yíduì tiěliào , mù zuò yě shì shàng huí nà zhī .
pairs.english: On the table was still the same pair of iron pieces Tavi habitually used, and the wooden seat was the one from last time.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上的仍是塔维用惯的那一对铁料，木座也是上回那只。

pairs.target: lǎoshī chóngxīn hé guò wánzhěng tǐjī , bǎ zhīdiǎn , xiànwèi hé qīngzài zhúxiàng duì zhàojiù jìlù , méiyǒu huàn fúdù .
pairs.english: The teacher checked their full volumes again, comparing the pivots, stops and light loads against the old record item by item, without changing the amplitude.
pairs.hanzi: 老师重新核过完整体积，把支点、限位和轻载逐项对照旧记录，没有换幅度。

pairs.target: luò héng shēnshǒu shì luógǎn , wèn zhōngjiān wèishénme yídìng yào tíng .
pairs.english: Lohen reached out to try the screw, asking why they had to pause halfway.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡伸手试螺杆，问中间为什么一定要停。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō shàngcì tíng zài nàlǐ , zìjǐ guānggù zhe děng hòubànduàn , jiānbǎng xiān wǎngqián còu le .
pairs.english: Tavi said that last time they had paused there, he had been so intent on waiting for the latter part that his shoulder had leaned forward first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说上次停在那里，自己光顾着等后半段，肩膀先往前凑了。

pairs.target: " nà wǒ tíng le yǐhòu , nǐ gàosù wǒ shénme shíhòu jìxù ? "
pairs.english: “So after I stop, you will tell me when to continue?”
pairs.hanzi: “那我停了以后，你告诉我什么时候继续？”

pairs.target: luò héng bǎshǒu liúzài luógǎn shàng , kàn de shì tǎ wéi , búshì lǎoshī .
pairs.english: Lohen kept his hand on the screw, looking at Tavi rather than the teacher.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把手留在螺杆上，看的是塔维，不是老师。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng shuō zhào yuánlái nàyàng , huàdàozuǐbiān , cái tīng chū yuánlái nàyàng duì luò héng méishénme yòng .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to say to do it as before, but only as the words reached his lips did he realize that “as before” was little use to Lohen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想说照原来那样，话到嘴边，才听出原来那样对洛衡没什么用。

pairs.target: lǎoshī zài mù zuò shàng biāochū tíng chù , tā zhǐzhe nàtiáo huàxiàn , shuōmíng zhuǎn dào nǎlǐ , zěnyàng tíng , zìjǐ huì zěnyàng jiào tā jìxù huò fàngxià .
pairs.english: The teacher marked a stopping point on the wooden seat; pointing at that line, he explained how far to turn, how to stop, and how he would ask his partner to continue or lower it.
pairs.hanzi: 老师在木座上标出停处，他指着那条划线，说明转到哪里，怎样停，自己会怎样叫他继续或放下。

pairs.target: luò héng tīng wán , yāoqiú bǎ diézi nuókāi , miǎnde gēbozhǒu pèngfān , yòu wèn zìjǐ néng bunéng xiān shì .
pairs.english: After listening, Lohen asked for the dish to be moved out of the way so his elbow wouldn't knock it over, then asked if he could try first.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡听完，要求把碟子挪开，免得胳膊肘碰翻，又问自己能不能先试。

alignment.english: to be moved out of the way

pairs.target: tāmen xiān bú zuò jiāohuàn , bǎ zhěngtào dòngzuò kōng yǎn le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: They rehearsed the entire sequence once, without performing an exchange first.
pairs.hanzi: 他们先不做交换，把整套动作空演了一遍。

pairs.target: dào huàxiàn chù , luò héng tíngzhù , tǎ wéi què xiàyìshí dìdiǎn le tóu .
pairs.english: At the line, Lohen stopped, but Tavi nodded instinctively.
pairs.hanzi: 到划线处，洛衡停住，塔维却下意识地点了头。

pairs.target: luò héng méiyǒu jiēzhe zhuǎn : " zhège suàn jìxù , háishì nǐ tīngjiàn le ? "
pairs.english: Lohen did not keep turning: “Does that mean continue, or that you heard?”
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡没有接着转：“这个算继续，还是你听见了？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ěrgēn rè le , gǎichéng zhíjiē shuōhuà , yòu yǎn le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi’s ears grew hot; he switched to saying it aloud, and they rehearsed once more.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维耳根热了，改成直接说话，又演了一遍。

pairs.target: zhēnzhèng kāishǐ qián , wéi lǎoshī jiǎnchá mù zuò xià de chéngtuō , ràng luò héng bǎ zìjǐ de shǒu fàng huí gāngcái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Before they really began, Instructor Vey checked the support under the wooden seat and told Lohen to put his hand back in its previous position.
pairs.hanzi: 真正开始前，维老师检查木座下的承托，让洛衡把自己的手放回刚才的位置。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu jiēchù liǎngjiàn tiěliào , xiān niàn chū qīngzài xià de yuánshǐ dúshù , cái kāishǐ nà yìdiǎn shúxī de jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi touched the two iron pieces with both hands, first read out the baseline readings under the light load, then began that familiar small exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手接触两件铁料，先念出轻载下的原始读数，才开始那一点熟悉的交换。

pairs.target: luò héng zhuǎn dào huàxiàn , biàn tíngxià le .
pairs.english: Lohen turned to the line and stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡转到划线，便停下了。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén pǎo guò , xiédǐ dài zhe shuǐ , pādā pādā dì xiǎng , tǎ wéi méi qù cāi shì shuí .
pairs.english: Someone ran past outside the window, their shoes wet and pattering; Tavi did not try to guess who it was.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人跑过，鞋底带着水，啪嗒啪嗒地响，塔维没去猜是谁。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn luò héng shǒubèi yǒu yìtiáo gāng xǐ guò de huī hén , yě kànjiàn luógǎn hái méi zǒu wán de nà yìxiǎo jié .
pairs.english: He saw Lohen’s hand, its back bearing a freshly washed grey streak, and saw the little distance the screw still had to travel.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见洛衡手背有一条刚洗过的灰痕，也看见螺杆还没走完的那一小截。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí , nà yìxiǎo jié méiyǒu zài tā nǎozilǐ zìjǐ wǎngqián pǎo .
pairs.english: This time, that little distance did not run ahead on its own inside his head.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回，那一小截没有在他脑子里自己往前跑。

pairs.target: tā děng hūxī shùn le , cái shuō : " jìxù . "
pairs.english: He waited until his breathing settled before saying, “Continue.”
pairs.hanzi: 他等呼吸顺了，才说：“继续。”

pairs.target: luò héng àn yuē zhuǎnwán , shǒu méiyǒu lìkè líkāi mù zuò , wéi lǎoshī fǔshēn kànguò gùdìng chù , jiào tā bǎochí yuánwèi .
pairs.english: Lohen finished turning as agreed and did not immediately take his hand away from the wooden seat; Instructor Vey bent down to examine the fastening and told him to stay in position.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡按约转完，手没有立刻离开木座，维老师俯身看过固定处，叫他保持原位。

alignment.english: did not immediately take his hand away from

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ jiāohuàn shōuhuí , liǎngbiān zài qīngzài xià huīfù yuánlái de dúshù , lǎoshī hézhǔn hòu , cái ràng tā táishǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi withdrew the exchange; both sides returned to their original readings under the light load, and only after the teacher confirmed them did she let him lift his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把交换收回，两边在轻载下恢复原来的读数，老师核准后，才让他抬手。

pairs.target: xièzài shí , tā rěnbúzhù dīng zhe mù zuò , xiàng děng yìzhī gāng fàngkāi de niǎo fēi zǒu .
pairs.english: When unloading, he could not help staring at the wooden seat, as though waiting for a newly released bird to fly away.
pairs.hanzi: 卸载时，他忍不住盯着木座，像等一只刚放开的鸟飞走。

pairs.target: mù zuò méi dòng , pǔtōng luógǎn liúzhù le tā , xiàmiàn de chéngtuō yě hái zài , bìng méiyǒu ná tā qù xuán dōngxī .
pairs.english: The wooden seat did not move: the ordinary screw held it, the support underneath remained in place, and they had not used it to suspend anything.
pairs.hanzi: 木座没动，普通螺杆留住了它，下面的承托也还在，并没有拿它去悬东西。

pairs.target: luò héng xiān sōng le kǒuqì , suíhòu wèn : " wǒ xiànzài zǒngnéng náo yíxiàliǎn le ba ? "
pairs.english: Lohen first let out a relieved breath, then asked, “Can I finally scratch my face now?”
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡先松了口气，随后问：“我现在总能挠一下脸了吧？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái fāxiàn tā bízi pángbiān zhān zhe yìdiǎn mùxiè .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi notice a bit of sawdust stuck beside his nose.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才发现他鼻子旁边沾着一点木屑。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén tóngshí xiào le , luò héng yòng shǒuwàn cèng le liǎngxià , fǎnér bǎ mùxiè cèng dào le méimáo shàng .
pairs.english: Both of them laughed at once; Lohen rubbed twice with his wrist, only to rub the sawdust onto his eyebrow instead.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人同时笑了，洛衡用手腕蹭了两下，反而把木屑蹭到了眉毛上。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ xiǎo jìngzi dìgěi tā , zìjǐ qù jì xièzài hòu de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey handed him a small mirror, then went to record the results of the checks after unloading.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把小镜子递给他，自己去记卸载后的检查结果。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hēshuǐ shí , shǒuzhǐ néng gǎnjué dào bēikǒu de xìxiǎo quē chù , yǎnjīng yě méiyǒu shàng huí nàzhǒng bēngjǐn de gǎnjué .
pairs.english: As Tavi drank, his fingers could feel the tiny chip in the cup’s rim, and his eyes lacked that taut sensation from last time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝水时，手指能感觉到杯口的细小缺处，眼睛也没有上回那种绷紧的感觉。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu yāoqiú zài lái yícì , zhǐ wèn luò héng zìjǐ de liànxí shì shénme .
pairs.english: He did not ask to try again, only asked what Lohen’s own exercise was.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有要求再来一次，只问洛衡自己的练习是什么。

pairs.target: luò héng cóng zhuō dǐ bānchū yìzhī zhǎi jiàzi , shuō yào xiān zhǎo qīng shòulì chù , shěngde měicì sōng luódīng dōu chāi cuò yìbiān .
pairs.english: Lohen brought a narrow frame out from under the table, saying he needed to first locate where the forces acted, to avoid dismantling the wrong side every time he loosened a screw.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡从桌底搬出一只窄架子，说要先找清受力处，省得每次松螺钉都拆错一边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi guòqù tì tā fúzhù jiàzi , què méiyǒu tì tā zhǐ dáàn .
pairs.english: Tavi went over to steady the frame for him, but did not point out the answer on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维过去替他扶住架子，却没有替他指答案。

pairs.target: luò héng ràng tā wǎng zuǒ nuó xiē , guò le yíhuìer , yòu bǎ tā jiào huí yuánchù , shuō gāngcái kànlòu le dǐxià yìgēn xié chēng .
pairs.english: Lohen told him to move a little to the left, then after a while called him back to his original position, saying he had overlooked a diagonal brace underneath earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡让他往左挪些，过了一会儿，又把他叫回原处，说刚才看漏了底下一根斜撑。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí , děng zhe shuō jìxù de rén huàn le yígè .
pairs.english: This time, someone else was waiting to say continue.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回，等着说继续的人换了一个。

pairs.target: xiàkèshí , tǎ wéi bǎ tiěliào jiāohuí guì lǐ , wéi lǎoshī zhújiàn quèrèn , luò héng zài pángbiān cuī tā kuàidiǎn .
pairs.english: At the end of class, Tavi returned the iron pieces to the cabinet; Instructor Vey checked each one while Lohen urged him to hurry from beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 下课时，塔维把铁料交回柜里，维老师逐件确认，洛衡在旁边催他快点。

pairs.target: tā yào qù chīfàn , fāngcái nà diǎn kèzhōng zǎoyǐ búgòu , dùzi zhèng xiǎng de bùkěn jiǎngdàolǐ .
pairs.english: He wanted lunch; that quarter hour had long since proved too short, and his stomach was rumbling too loudly to listen to reason.
pairs.hanzi: 他要去吃饭，方才那点刻钟早已不够，肚子正响得不肯讲道理。
